description:
Which are the top 10 best stocks to buy now with low risk & high returns. How do we find these best growth stocks for long term investment. Watch the video to find out
🔴 Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMkmYSiSQKsy0mibf5mN7qw?sub_confirmation=1

In this video we will discuss the following pointers 
10 Stocks to buy now in Large cap and Midcap
The concept of Alpha and Beta for top stocks
Screener for growth stocks
Stock Fundamental Analysis of below stocks
Which of the good stocks are expensive or at reasonable valuations

We have discussed about the following stocks

1st Stock is a Indian Retail story based on consumption know as Dmart Share or also avenues supermarts stock
We have talked about dmart share analysis along with dmart share future prospects and are the valuations reasonable or not ? Is it the best stock to buy now or one can wait for correction ?

2nd stock that we discussed is hcl tech share. We discussed fundamental of HCL Tech stock analysis and compared valuation with TCS stock and Infosys share to see how inexpensive it. Reason why I prefer HCL Tech stock over other 2

Next stock that we discussed was that of stock in cement sector and a leader by the name of ultratech stock where we did a minor ultratech cement stock analysis to see if ultratech cement share is best stock to buy now as an infrastructure play ?

4th we discussed about Nestle Stock and did a short nestle share analysis. Nestle review showed lot of promise as best stock to buy now for long term investment and one the top large cap stocks compounding consistently as seen in the fundamental analysis

5th we discussed about icici lombard and did quick review or icici lombard stock analysis

6th stock that we discussed was that of divi's lab share and did a quick divis lab share analysis in less than a minute which belongs to API industry part of Pharma

Next we covered a midcap stocks which belong to IT sector like HCL Tech share and the share we covered was that mindtree. mind tree share analysis again showed lot of promises of being one of the top growth stocks for long term and we discussed about the valuations too of the stock

8th stock was that of LTTS or LArsen and Tubro Technology services. LTTS stock is again of the top AI stocks compounding consistently. We also discussed about the alpha and beta of the same

9th stock was that of balkrishna industries. On doing balkrishna stock analysis we again found positive pointers mostly and discussed alpha and beta too for balkrishna share

Finally we discussed about PI industries share in agrochemical sectors, the financials of the pi stock along with the alpha and beta and if it is really a good growth stock
